notes:
What's new in 0.1.125:
- Sharing with another household: you accept an invite with the share code alone and one Accept invite button, with no e-mail, password or guest box. German share-code wording uses formal Sie.
- Link a TV: a TV you remove loses its connection to the home PC within minutes, including profiles switched on that TV.
- Campsite: the owner can host a Campsite from this computer for guests on the same Wi-Fi (in development), with limits per guest device and translated screens.
- Users: removing a household member removes only the settings, sessions and party access of that person, keeps the settings of every other member, and refuses to remove the last owner. No videos, exports or backups are deleted.
- Jellyfin apps: when Live TV is switched on, Jellyfin apps can list channels and the guide and play a channel (read-only).
- Live TV recording: stopping, cancelling or resuming a recording keeps the parts already recorded, a lost tuner resumes, cancelled series airings are skipped, channel logos inside M3U lists show, and counts use the right plural.
- DLNA speakers: playback resumes after a speaker scan ages out, speakers show the track name and details, and old speakers drop off the list.
- Backup and restore: messages are accurate and translated, the restore preview says which items will be replaced, and the parental PIN and backup passphrase are checked without freezing the app.
- Watching in the browser: after a seek the subtitle for the new spot shows at once, going Back to Movies keeps your search, a podcast speed chosen while settings load is kept, phone speakers no longer flicker Out of sync, and pressing Movie Night again brings the open room forward.
- Smaller fixes: Up Next and Previous handle files that hold two episodes; sizes just under a unit show as the next unit and broken lengths show as zero; zh-Hant metadata uses Traditional Chinese; Remote Desktop says No picture yet when nothing arrives; asking for a title again reopens a closed request; Family Watch never shows empty extra tiles; the window keeps a 640-pixel minimum width; layout dialogs open with visible focus; the Get the app page shows dates in the page language.
- Separate server changes: share-code-only invites (about 7:45 AM Eastern) and the faster Link a TV removal check plus the party rejoin fix (about 8:45 AM Eastern) went live on the Beebo server on Nov 17, 2026; none of this is part of the Windows installer.
- Windows only. The phone app (1.73, build 145) and Beebo Auto (1.22) are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite ran on the merged changes (2,082 files) and everything passed except 3 guard tests, whose two causes were fixed before this build; a re-run of the 482 affected files then passed except 2 that failed only from test-machine memory or timing and passed when run alone. Each change had a clear code review (two for protected changes), and the signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full suite was not re-run after the version-number change, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 1b60ec7dd.
- Built: Nov 17, 2026, 9:01 AM Eastern.
- Published: Jan 1, 2099, 12:00 AM Eastern.
